independent_check.original_and_assumptions: Read original Section4.2 p5: resize256 then center crop224 at test time. Direct static reading of datasets/__init__.py42-61 and test.py39-45 confirms only CenterCrop224/ToTensor in the evaluation loader; training has Resize256. Rebuild shell and full README show link organization rather than pixel resizing.
independent_check.independent_derivation: For a hypothetical square1024 image, fresh exact fractions give native crop area(224/1024)^2=0.0478515625 versus resize-first source-coordinate footprint(224/256)^2=0.765625, ratio16. This is a geometric example, not an observed image-dataset distribution or prediction.
independent_check.counterevidence_and_scope: External preprocessing to256 could reconcile the pipelines; no historical dataset chain or saved predictions are available. Square geometry deliberately avoids the integer-Resize aspect-ratio issue. The included rebuild script does not itself supply that reconciliation.
independent_check.severity_and_repair: Minor retained for release reproduction and method-description consistency. Choose and document the actual transform, then rerun matched data for empirical effect; only the coordinate difference is verified here.

independent_check.original_and_assumptions: Read Figure2 p3, Figure4/Section4.5 p7, and original p7 image; both text and caption say final-layer model features. Train/test create num_classes1024. Static tsne_script.py35-51 loads the same shape, replaces fc with Identity, then obtains features, so its current path bypasses the trained classification projection.
independent_check.independent_derivation: Fresh direct norms for a=(0,100),b=(1,0),c=(2,100),W=(1,0) give d(a,c)=2<d(a,b)=100.00499987500625, but projected d(a,b)=1<d(a,c)=2. A non-isometric trained projection need not preserve the backbone neighbours shown in a plot.
independent_check.counterevidence_and_scope: The public script is not a pinned historical figure-generation record. Backbone visualizations can still be useful if labelled, and a two-dimensional t-SNE layout cannot certify original-space distances or quantitative generalization. No historical plot error or accuracy failure is proved.
independent_check.severity_and_repair: Minor retained for representation provenance. Retain the1024-output projection for metric-space analysis, or name the backbone representation and add a separate post-head analysis. No t-SNE or model run was executed.

Fresh Table1 means84.0666667,77.05,72.4833333 round as printed;84.1-72.5=11.6 percentage points. Read evaluation shell, train shell, parser, README and selected train/test code.
